ChangeResourceGroup.title: ChangeResourceGroup
ChangeResourceGroup.summary: Changes the resource group for a cloud resource.

CheckServiceDeployable.title: CheckServiceDeployable
CheckServiceDeployable.summary: Performs a precheck to verify that a service instance can be deployed.

ContinueDeployServiceInstance.title: ContinueDeployServiceInstance
ContinueDeployServiceInstance.summary: If a service instance fails to deploy, you can call the ContinueDeployServiceInstance operation to resume the deployment.

CreateBackup.title: CreateBackup
CreateBackup.summary: Creates a backup for a Compute Nest service instance.

CreateServiceInstance.title: CreateServiceInstance
CreateServiceInstance.summary: Creates and deploys a service instance in Compute Nest by specifying parameters such as a region ID, a service instance name, and a service ID.

CreateSkillFileDetect.title: Create a skill file detection task
CreateSkillFileDetect.summary: Creates a Skill file detection task.

DeleteBackup.title: DeleteBackup
DeleteBackup.summary: Deletes a Compute Nest instance backup.

DeleteServiceInstances.title: DeleteServiceInstances
DeleteServiceInstances.summary: Deletes the specified service instances in a region.

GenerateServicePolicy.title: Query service access policies
GenerateServicePolicy.summary: Queries the missing access policies before creating a service instance.

GetBackup.title: GetBackup
GetBackup.summary: Retrieves the details of a backup.

GetNetworkAvailableZones.title: GetNetworkAvailableZones
GetNetworkAvailableZones.summary: Returns a list of available zones for a specified region.

GetService.title: GetService
GetService.summary: Retrieves the details of a specified service.

GetServiceEstimateCost.title: GetServiceEstimateCost
GetServiceEstimateCost.summary: Queries the estimated cost of creating a service instance.

GetServiceInstance.title: GetServiceInstance
GetServiceInstance.summary: Queries the details of a service instance by its region ID, service instance ID, or Alibaba Cloud Marketplace instance ID. The returned information includes the service status, template name, and a list of resources.

GetServiceInstanceSubscriptionEstimateCo.title: GetServiceInstanceSubscriptionEstimateCost
GetServiceInstanceSubscriptionEstimateCo.summary: Queries the estimated renewal cost of subscription resources in a privately deployed service instance. You can query the cost for all resources associated with a service instance ID, or for a specific set of resources.

GetServiceProvisions.title: GetServiceProvisions
GetServiceProvisions.summary: Retrieves the provisions of a service, such as its activation status and service roles.

GetServiceTemplateParameterConstraints.title: GetServiceTemplateParameterConstraints
GetServiceTemplateParameterConstraints.summary: Queries the parameter constraints for a Resource Orchestration Service (ROS) template in a specified region using the template name and service ID.

GetSkill.title: View skill details
GetSkill.summary: Queries the details of a Skill.

GetSkillFileDetectResult.title: GetSkillFileDetectResult
GetSkillFileDetectResult.summary: Retrieves the result of a Skill file detection task.

GetSkillSpace.title: View skillSpace details
GetSkillSpace.summary: Queries the details of a SkillSpace.

ListBackups.title: ListBackups
ListBackups.summary: Queries a list of backups for Compute Nest service instances.

ListPolicies.title: ListPolicies
ListPolicies.summary: Retrieves a list of access policies.

ListPublicSkills.title: Query public skill list
ListPublicSkills.summary: Queries the list of public skills.

ListRestoreTasks.title: ListRestoreTasks
ListRestoreTasks.summary: Queries a list of restore jobs.

ListServiceInstanceBill.title: ListServiceInstanceBill
ListServiceInstanceBill.summary: Call the ListServiceInstanceBill operation to query bills for service instances.

ListServiceInstanceLogs.title: ListServiceInstanceLogs
ListServiceInstanceLogs.summary: Retrieves the deployment and upgrade logs of a service instance.

ListServiceInstanceResources.title: ListServiceInstanceResources
ListServiceInstanceResources.summary: Queries the resources of a service instance based on parameters such as the service instance ID, Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN), and region ID.

ListServiceInstanceUpgradeHistory.title: ListServiceInstanceUpgradeHistory

ListServiceInstances.title: ListServiceInstances

ListSkillFiles.title: Retrieve skill file list
ListSkillFiles.summary: Retrieves the list of skill files.

ListTagKeys.title: ListTagKeys
ListTagKeys.summary: This operation lists existing tag keys.

ListTagResources.title: ListTagResources
ListTagResources.summary: Queries a list of tagged resources.

ListTagValues.title: ListTagValues
ListTagValues.summary: Lists the tag values for a specified tag key.

RenewServiceInstanceResources.title: RenewServiceInstanceResources
RenewServiceInstanceResources.summary: Renews the subscription resources for a private deployment service instance. This operation supports two renewal methods: renewing all subscription resources for a service instance or renewing only specific resources. You can use only one method per request.

RestartServiceInstance.title: RestartServiceInstance
RestartServiceInstance.summary: Restarts a service instance in the Deployed state.

RollbackServiceInstance.title: RollbackServiceInstance
RollbackServiceInstance.summary: Rolls back an upgraded service instance.

StartServiceInstance.title: StartServiceInstance
StartServiceInstance.summary: Call the StartServiceInstance operation to start a service instance that is in the Stopped or StartFailed state.

StopServiceInstance.title: StopServiceInstance
StopServiceInstance.summary: Call the StopServiceInstance operation to shut down a service instance that is in the Deployed or StopFailed state.

TagResources.title: TagResources
TagResources.summary: You can call TagResources to create and attach tags to multiple resources.

UpdateServiceInstanceAttributes.title: UpdateServiceInstanceAttributes
UpdateServiceInstanceAttributes.summary: Updates the attributes of a service instance.

UpdateServiceInstanceSpec.title: UpdateServiceInstanceSpec
UpdateServiceInstanceSpec.summary: You can call the UpdateServiceInstanceSpec operation to upgrade or downgrade a service instance if its parameters or package settings do not meet your requirements.

UpdateServiceUsage.title: UpdateServiceUsage
UpdateServiceUsage.summary: Updates the information about a service usage request.

UpdateUserInformation.title: UpdateUserInformation
UpdateUserInformation.summary: The UpdateUserInformation operation updates user information.

UpgradeServiceInstance.title: UpgradeServiceInstance
UpgradeServiceInstance.summary: Upgrades a service instance to a new version.

ValidateServiceInstanceName.title: ValidateServiceInstanceName
ValidateServiceInstanceName.summary: Validates the name of a service instance.
